items.title: Sit On Everything 2.1.0 Add-on
items.creator: Owls Cubed
items.description:
Sit on literally everything! Blocks, mobs, players, projectiles!
Ride mobs, sit with animations, and set custom sitting positions yourself! Works for absolutely everything across all addons and worlds!
Pure chaos and endless fun!
items.changelog:
UPDATE 2.1.0:
+ Added the “Animation Switcher” item for quick animation switching.
+ Added a “Global Settings” menu where you can disable sitting on fireworks.
+ Added a section for recently used animations in the animation selection menu.
+ To cancel an animation, use Double Sneak.
+ Fixes.

items.title: Mob Farm in a Block Add-On
items.creator: EduElfie
items.description:
This Add-On allows you to trap mobs from the Overworld, Nether and The End in nets and place them in farms to harvest their drops. It also has 8 different upgrades that you can use to make the farms faster, automated and to give more loot per growth cycle.

This item can be applied to any world, new or existing and transform your Minecraft experience!
items.changelog:
New Features at your Request:
- New Farm UI - manage mobs, upgrades and loot
- New farmable mobs - Armadillo, Mounts of Mayhem and Climate Variants
- Two New Upgrades - Raid and Bartering

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed farm mobs disappearing
- Fixed Rabbit loot
- Fixed texture bleeding of some mobs

items.changelog: Added groups, Guidesheet, +210 new blocks, +5 NPCs (WIP), and new systems: doors, expandable windows, blinds, roofs, bathtubs, strip lights, and series lights. Fixed slabs, spawn eggs, NPC IDs, item catalog, and folders. Updated GUI, TV assets, windows, wall clock, key art, and panorama.
